scan.title: Scan
scan.hint: Point the camera at the code, or use a scanner gun — it types the code into the box below.
scan.anyHint: Scan a student or staff ID card, a library book, a fee receipt or a certificate.
scan.typePlaceholder: Or type the code / scan with a scanner gun
scan.unknownHint: Nothing you can see matches this code. It may belong to another school, or to a class or module you don't work with.

camera.denied: The camera is blocked for this site. Allow it in the browser's settings, or use a scanner gun / type the code.
camera.none: No camera found on this device — use a scanner gun or type the code.
camera.error: The camera couldn't start. Use a scanner gun or type the code.

gate.title: Gate scanner
gate.subtitle: Scan ID cards as students or staff come in and go out. Each scan goes to the gate log; the family hears when a child reaches school.
gate.none: No gate scanner set up yet. Add one in Integrations › Devices as a “Phone / tablet scanner” — then open this screen on that phone.
gate.marksPresent: A child's first scan before the “mark by” time marks them present.
gate.offline: Couldn't reach the server — this scan wasn't saved. Scan again.

punch.title: My attendance code
punch.hint: Show this at the staff gate scanner to mark yourself in or out. It changes every 30 seconds, so a photo of it won't work later.

receipt.valid: {{school}} issued this receipt and it is valid.
receipt.cancelled: {{school}} issued this receipt but later cancelled it — it no longer counts as paid.
receipt.notFound: No receipt matches this code. It may have been altered — ask the school's fee office.
receipt.compare: Check these match the printed receipt.

exam.notToday: No paper today — the next is on {{date}}.
exam.noMore: No more papers in this exam.
exam.notFound: No hall ticket or report card matches this code. It may have been altered — ask the school.
exam.valid: {{school}} issued this for the exam below.
exam.compare: Check these match the printed document.

tc.valid: {{school}} issued this transfer certificate and it is valid.
tc.cancelled: {{school}} issued this TC but later cancelled it — it is no longer valid.
tc.notFound: No issued transfer certificate matches this code. It may have been altered — ask the school that issued it.
tc.compare: Check these match the printed TC.

valid.EVENT_PASS: Valid pass — not checked in yet
valid.PICKUP_PASS: Valid for today — check the person, then hand over

pass.notValid: Not valid — used, cancelled or for another day
pass.checkId: Ask for photo ID and match the name before handing over.
